events.text: Georges Duby was born.

events.quote: Georges Duby ( 7 October 1919 – 3 December 1996 ) was a French historian

events.text: Georges Duby died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Georges Duby ( 7 October 1919 – 3 December 1996 ) was a French historian

events.text: Duby earned an undergraduate degree at Lyon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He earned an undergraduate degree at Lyon in 1942

events.text: Duby completed his graduate thesis at the Sorbonne.
events.subject: self
events.quote: completed his graduate thesis at the Sorbonne under Charles-Edmond Perrin in 1952

events.text: Duby was appointed to the Chair of the History of Medieval Society in the Collège de France.
events.subject: self
events.object: Chair of the History of Medieval Society
events.quote: he was appointed in 1970 to the Chair of the History of Medieval Society in the Collège de France

events.text: Duby's attachment to the Collège ended with his retirement.

events.quote: He remained attached to the Collège until his retirement in 1991

events.text: Duby was elected to the Académie française.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was elected to the Académie française in 1987
